scripts.lint: oxlint app/src service tv scripts vite.config.ts && stylelint "app/src/**/*.css"
scripts.format: oxfmt app/src service tv scripts vite.config.ts
scripts.format:check: oxfmt --check app/src service tv scripts vite.config.ts
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run compiler && npm run test && npm run lint && npm run format:check
scripts.install:service: npm run package && ares-install -d tv dist/com.glexe.sei_${npm_package_version}_all.ipk && npm run elevate
scripts.elevate: ssh root@${TV_HOST:?set TV_HOST to the TV IP} /media/developer/apps/usr/palm/services/org.webosbrew.hbchannel.service/elevate-service com.glexe.sei.service && ssh root@${TV_HOST} 'pkill -f com.glexe.sei.service || true'
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run install:home
